title: change_prepare payloads by change kind
description: One payload schema per change kind in $defs, keyed by kind; x-external-payloads names kinds whose payload another contract defines. Derived from the worker's payload parsers; the worker stays authoritative and checks more than a schema can (native identities, allowlists that depend on the target, cross-field rules). Kinds with additionalProperties true ignore unknown fields in the worker; strict kinds refuse them. Top-level change_prepare arguments (projectName, plcPath, scopePath, intent) are not part of the payload. Only the kinds whose schema has a batch branch take payload.items. Strings are refused when blank or whitespace-only, and integers must be JSON integers (5, not 5.0); a schema cannot say either. Length caps on selector paths are client-side guidance.
